comment: The accepted behaviour changes of the migration of 2.2 machines, each model with the kind of difference it shows against its 3.1.0 result (scripts/compatibility-machines.mjs, acceptedDifferences).

models.difference: C-3: an if test in a migrated block is no scheduling step; a noEnabledTransition discard and a line of the machine run in the other order
C-3: the machine's write moves before another component's write
C-3: the machine reaches a state before another component publishes, so the state takes a message that 2.2 dropped (also with 2.2's queue order)
r10: owned input is looked at in delivery order, not in the order the queues were created, which also decides what is dropped
